create_Histogram: create a Histogram instance with a given resolution and max possible value for performance testing
add_Histogram_value: add a value to the Histogram to record performance data and update bucket counts
get_Histogram_data: get the Histogram data as a HistogramData protobuf message with buckets and statistics
merge_Histogram_data: merge another HistogramData protobuf message into the current Histogram to combine statistics
reset_Histogram: reset the Histogram to clear all recorded values, buckets, and statistics
